title: Invalid hook call after adding a workspace UI package, pnpm, default Metro config
notes: Every clue points at duplicate React and the answer should take one command to confirm. The user is on Expo with the default metro.config.js and no .npmrc. The correct response depends on their Expo SDK: from SDK 52 expo/metro-config configures watchFolders automatically, and from SDK 54 isolated pnpm installs are supported — so blanket 'add watchFolders and node-linker=hoisted' is outdated advice that can itself cause problems. A good answer names duplicate React as the cause, gives a command to confirm it, and ASKS WHICH SDK before prescribing config. 'Works in apps/web' is corroborating: web bundlers dedupe differently. The failure mode being tested is twofold — investigating hook usage the user already ruled out, or reciting the pre-SDK-52 monorepo setup as though it were universal.
